source_mechanism_review.home_timer: Home schedules refresh at access expiry minus 25 seconds and popup at access expiry.
source_mechanism_review.missing_refresh: Timeout controller calls continuLogout immediately when refreshToken is absent.
source_mechanism_review.button_disable: continuLogout sets loading true; LoadingButton renders disabled buttons while loading. Extend is therefore disabled after automatic logout starts.
source_mechanism_review.expiry_error: errorHandler clears storage when the error contains TOKEN_INVALID_EXPIRED.
source_mechanism_review.profile_photo: Avatar uses a direct img src to an external profile URL. This request does not pass through Axios errorHandler and cannot itself dispatch CLEAR.
source_mechanism_review.analytics: Analytics uses Axios, but errorHandler explicitly excludes /api/analytics/ from its authentication-clearing branch. An analytics 404 therefore does not explain the observed CLEAR from this source path.
